summary: Retest of client-side pagination (PAGE_SIZE=20). Fixture: added 45 TEMP clients, each with a TEMP vehicle (59 clients / 63 vehicles in total), plus 25 TEMP products (81 in total). Invoices (82 fiscal), work orders (92) and products were already over 20 from seed data. Desktop 1920: Clients shows 20/20/19 rows; summary reads 1–20, 21–40 and 41–59 din 59; Pagina x/3; previous is disabled on page 1 and next on the last page; previous goes back correctly. Search ('TEMP Pag Client 4' gives 5 rows and no controls; 'TEMP Pag' gives 45 rows and Pagina 1/3) and the all/pf/pj filters reset to page 1, even when starting from page 2 or 3. No blank page: pj shows the empty state. Vehicles show 20/20/20/3 rows (63 total, 4 pages). Invoices show 20x4 and 2 (82 total, 5 pages); the paid, unpaid, all, proforma and fiscal filters reset to page 1 starting from page 5, and lists of 20 or fewer hide the controls. Work orders list view shows 20x4 and 12 (92 total); a search with no matches gives 0 rows and no controls. Products show 20x4 and 1 (81 total); search and the low-stock filter reset to Pagina 1/2. NIR (4) and returns (3) correctly show no controls. Kanban shows 11 active cards with no controls. Mobile 390: on clients, vehicles, invoices, stock and work orders the controls fit (324–358px wide, 36px touch targets) and next works. Page-level horizontal overflow appears only on /stock (542px), caused by the TabsList and not by pagination. No page errors. Confirmed: the API still sends every object; there is no server-side pagination. All TEMP/TEST data was cleaned up, including leftovers from earlier runs.

minor.issue: There is no server-side pagination. The limit, skip and page params are ignored and the full array is returned: invoices about 195KB (89 objects), work-orders about 222KB (92), products 56–81 objects. Pagination only limits the DOM, not the network payload or load time. Hard caps silently cut off data: clients to_list(1000), work-orders 1000, invoices 2000, vehicles 2000, products 5000. Past these caps, records become invisible with no warning.

issues: The TabsList (5 tabs, whitespace-nowrap) overflows the page horizontally: document scrollWidth is 542 against a 390px viewport. This was not caused by pagination. Wrap it in overflow-x-auto or make the tabs scrollable.

Kanban columns use pagination.pageItems. Once there are more than 20 active work orders, each column shows only the cards on the current page, and the column counts become per-page rather than real totals. Consider not paginating kanban, or paginating per column.
Clicking next or previous does not scroll back to the top of the list. On mobile the user stays at the bottom of the new page (minor UX).

action_items: Optional (the user asked for faster loading): add server-side pagination (skip/limit and a total count) to the list endpoints. The current fix only limits rendering.
Fix horizontal overflow of the /stock TabsList on mobile.
Do not paginate the kanban view, or paginate it per column.
Add data-testid to work-orders list rows (work-order-row-{number}); they currently have none.
Optional: scroll the list into view when changing page.
critical_code_review_comments: The usePagination resetKey includes data.length, so a reload that changes the row count (create or delete) jumps back to page 1. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
WorkOrders.js applies pagination to both kanban and list views (visibleRows in the kanban filter).
The backend list endpoints use fixed to_list caps with no total or count, so data past the cap is silently dropped.

success_rate.frontend: 100% pagination checks passed; 1 unrelated mobile overflow on /stock
